_readme: This file is copied to ~/Ezra/config.json. `check` fills profileId and instagram by itself: never type an id by hand. The API key is NOT here, it lives in ~/Ezra/.env.
_newsletter_note: Optional. Where emails typed inside a DM go. Leave webhook_url empty and `emails` exports them to emails.csv instead. {{email_reply}} is replaced by what the person typed.

campaigns.name: my-first-bot
campaigns._trigger_note: comment = a comment under one post. story_reply = a reply to your story.
campaigns._match_note: contains = the word anywhere in the comment: catches 'אשמח לנשימה' and 'נשימה 🙏' (29% of real comments are more than the word). Safe because the rule belongs to one post. exact = the whole comment is the word: use it for story replies, and list the forms. word = whole word only: Zernio does not document it for Hebrew, test it first.
campaigns._dm_note: Message one GIVES, it does not ask. Say what they get, and end with an open door: 'questions? write to me here'.
campaigns.dm:
הנה זה 👇
PUT-WHAT-THEY-GET-HERE, בדיוק כמו שהבטחתי.
נתקעים או שיש שאלה? כותבים לי כאן, אני עונה ❤️
campaigns._buttons_note: Up to 3 buttons, including the remind and email buttons below. A title is 20 units at most, an emoji counts 2.
campaigns._public_note: Rotated under the comment so a row of identical replies does not look like a bot. after_dm = only if the DM really went out.
campaigns._gate_note: null = everyone gets the link at once (converts best). To ask for a follow first, replace null with: {"message": "...", "button": "עקבתי, שלח לי!", "not_following": "..."}. Give permission to leave: 'and if it does not help, unfollow with my blessing'.
campaigns._remind_note: Optional. Adds a button that re-sends the link after N hours (23 at most: Meta's 24h window). The title must not overlap another campaign's button.
campaigns._email_note: Optional. Adds a button that asks for their email inside the DM, and sends it to your newsletter.
